scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@footy-finder/shared && npm run build --workspace=@footy-finder/api-client
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n web,admin,api -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev --workspace=@footy-finder/web" "npm run dev --workspace=@footy-finder/admin" "npm run dev --workspace=@footy-finder/api"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=@footy-finder/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=@footy-finder/api
scripts.dev:admin: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=@footy-finder/admin
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@footy-finder/api && npm run build --workspace=@footy-finder/web && npm run build --workspace=@footy-finder/admin
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run build:packages && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
